Allah Ta'ala bayaan farmata hai ke usne insan ko paida kiya halanki usse pehle hawa, pani, haqarat aur zaif ki wajah se aisi cheez na tha ke zikr kiya jaye, use mard o aurat ke mile jule pani se paida kiya aur ajab ajab tabdiliyon ke baad yeh maujuda shakl o surat aur haiyat par aaya, use hum aazma rahe hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (LIYABLUWAKUM AYYUKUM AHSANU AMALAN WAHUWAL AFAZIZUL GHAFFUR) 67. Al-Mulk: 2 taake woh tumhe aazmaye ke tum mein se acche amal karne wala kaun hai? Pas usne tumhe kaan aur aankhein ata farmaye taake itaat aur masiyat mein tameez kar sako. Humne use raah dikha di, khoob wazih aur saaf kar ke apna seedha rasta us par khol diya, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (WA AMMA SAMUDU FAHADAINAHUM FASTAHABBUL AMA ALAL HUDA FAAKHADATHUM SAQATUL AZABIL HOUNI BIMA KANOU YAKSIBOUN) 41. Fussilat: 17 yani Samudiyon ko humne hidayat ki lekin unho ne andhe pan ko hidayat par tarjeeh di aur jagah hai ayat (WA HADAINAHUN NAJDAYN) 90. Al-Balad: 10 Humne insan ko dono raahein dikha di, yani bhalayi burayi ki, is ayat ki tafseer mein Mujahid, Abu Saleh, Zahhak aur Suddi se marwi hai ke use humne raah dikhayi yani maan ke pait se bahar aane ki, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai aur sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur jamhoor se yahi manqul hai. Shakiran aur Kafouran ka nasb haal ki wajah se zool-haal la ki zameer hai jo ayat (INNA HADAINAHUS SABILA IMMA SHAKIRAN WA IMMA KAFOURAN) 76. Al-Insan: 3 mein hai, yani woh is halat mein ya toh shaqi hai ya saeed hai, jaise Sahih Muslim ki hadis mein hai ke har shakhs subh ke waqt apne nafs ki khareed-o-frookht karta hai ya toh use halak kar deta hai ya aazad kara leta hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujrah ؓ se Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Allah tujhe bewakoofon ki sardari se bachaye. Hazrat Ka'ab ne kaha: Ya Rasulallah ﷺ! Woh kya hai? Farmaya: Woh mere baad ke sardar honge jo meri sunnaton par na amal karenge na mere tareeqon par chalenge, pas jo log unki jhoot ki tasdeeq karein aur unke zulm ki imdad karein, woh na mere hain aur na main unka hoon. Yaad rakho, woh mere Hauz-e-Kusar par bhi nahi aa sakte aur jo unke jhoot ko sacha na kare aur unke zulmon mein unka madadgar na bane, woh mera hai aur main uska hoon, yeh log mere Hauz-e-Kusar par mujhe milenge. Ae Ka'ab! Roza dhal hai aur sadqa khataon ko mita deta hai aur namaz qurb-e-Allah ka sabab hai ya farmaya ke daleel-e-nijat hai.

Ai Ka'b! Woh gosht post Jannat mein nahi ja sakta, woh haram se pala ho, woh toh Jahannam mein hi jaane ke qabil hai. Ai Ka'b! Log har subah apne nafs ki kharido-farokht karte hain, koi toh use azaad kara leta hai aur koi halak kar guzarta hai. Surah Rum ki ayat (Fitratallahil-lati fataran-nasa 'alaiha, la tabdila likhalqillah, zalikad-dinul-qayyim, wa lakin aksaran-nasa la ya'lamun) (30. Ar-Rum: 30) ki tafsir mein Hazrat Jabir R.H ki riwayat se Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farman bhi guzar chuka hai ke har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai yahan tak ke zaban chalne lagti hai, phir ya toh shukr guzar banta hai ya nashukra. Musnad Ahmad ki aur hadis mein hai ke jo nikalne wala nikalta hai, uske darwaze par do jhandey hote hain, ek farishte ke hath mein, dusra shaitan ke hath mein. Pas agar woh us kaam ke liye nikla jo Allah ki marzi ka hai, toh farishta apna jhanda liye hue uske sath ho leta hai aur yeh wapsi tak farishte ke jhande tale hi rehta hai, aur agar Allah ki narazgi ke kaam ke liye nikla hai toh shaitan apna jhanda lagaye uske sath ho leta hai aur wapsi tak yeh shetani jhande tale rehta hai.

Yahan Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke uski makhlooq mein se jo bhi usse kufr kare uske liye zanjeerein, tauq aur sholon wali bhadakti hui tez aag tayyar hai, jaise aur jagah hai: "Idhil-aghlalu fi a'naqihim was-salasilu yushabuna fil-hamimi thumma fin-nari yusjarun" (jabke tauq unki gardanon mein honge aur beriyan unke paon mein hongi aur yeh hamim mein ghaseete jayenge phir jahannam mein jalaye jayenge). In bad-naseebon ki saza ka zikr kar ke ab naik logon ki jaza ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhe woh jaam pilaye jayenge jinka mashroob kafoor naami nahar ke pani ka hoga, zaika bhi aala, khushbu bhi umdah aur faida bhi behtar, kafoor ki si thandak aur sonth ki si khushbu. Kafoor ek nahar ka naam hai jisse Allah ke khas bande pani peete hain aur sirf usi se aasudgi haasil karte hain, isiliye yahan isko "ba" se muta'addi kiya aur tameez ki bina par "ainal" par nasb diya. Yeh pani apni khushbu mein misl kafoor ke hai ya yeh theek kafoor hi hai aur ainal ka zabr yashrab ki wajah se hai. Phir is nahar tak unhe aane ki zaroorat nahi, yeh apne baghaat, makaanat, majlison aur baithkon mein jahan bhi jayenge is le jayenge aur wahin woh pahunch jayegi. Tafjeer ke maikhne rawani aur ijra ke hain, jaise aayat "Hatta tufajir lana" mein aur "Fajr-na khilalahuma" mein. 

Phir un logon ki nekiyan bayan ho rahi hain ke jo ibaadat Allah ki taraf se unke zimmah thi woh baja late thay balke jo cheez yeh apne upar kar lete use bhi baja late yaani nazr bhi poori karte. Hadees mein hai: "Jo Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ki nazr maane woh poori kare aur jo na-farmani ki nazr maane use poora na kare." Imam Bukhari ne ise Imam Malik ki riwayat se bayan farmaya. Aur Allah Ta'ala ki na-farmaniyon se bhagte rehte hain, kyunke qiyamat ke din ka dar hai jiski ghabrahat aam taur par sab ko gher legi aur har ek uljhan mein pad jayega magar jis par Allah ka rahm-o-karam ho. Zameen-o-asman tak haul rahe honge, istitaar ke maikhne hi hain phail jaane wali aur atraaf ko gher lene wali ke hain. Yeh neko-kaar Allah ki mohabbat mein mustahiq logon par apni taaqat ke mutabiq kharch bhi karte rehte thay aur "la" ki zameer ka marja baaz logon ne ta'am ko bhi kaha hai, lafzan zyada zahir bhi yahi hai, yaani bawajood ta'am ki mohabbat aur khwahish-o-zaroorat ke bawajood rah-e-Allah ghurba aur haajat-mandon ko de dete hain.

Jaise aur jagah hai: Wa atal-mala 'ala hubbihi, yaani maal ki chaahat ke bawajood use raah-e-Allah dete rehte hain, aur farmaan hai: Lan tanalul-birra hatta tunfiqo mimma tuhibbun, yaani tum hargiz bhalai haasil nahi kar sakte jab tak apni chaahat ki cheezein raah-e-Allah kharch na karo. 

Hazrat Nafi' farmate hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bimaar hue, aap ki bimaari mein angoor ka mausam aaya. Jab angoor bikne lage toh aap ka dil bhi chaaha ke main angoor khaoon. Aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Safiyah ne ek dirham ke angoor mangaye. Aadmi lekar aaya, uske saath hi saath ek sail bhi aa gaya aur usne aawaaz di ke main sail hoon. Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Yeh sab usi ko de do, chunancha de diye gaye. Phir dobaara aadmi gaya aur angoor khareed laya, ab ki martaba bhi sail aa gaya aur uske sawaal par usi ko sab ke sab angoor de diye gaye. Lekin ab ki martaba Hazrat Safiyah ne sail ko kahalwa bheja ke agar ab aaye toh tumhe kuch na milega. Chunancha teesri martaba ek dirham ke angoor mangwaye gaye (Baihaqi). 

Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke afzal sadaqa woh hai jo tu apni sehat ki haalat mein maal ki mohabbat, ameeri ki chaahat aur iflaas ke khauf ke bawajood raah-e-Allah de. Yaani maal ki hirs, hub bhi aur chaahat o zaroorat bhi ho, phir bhi raah-e-Allah use qurbaan kar de.

Yateem aur maskeen kise kehte hain? Iska mufassal bayaan pehle guzar chuka hai. 

 Qaidi ki nisbat Hazrat Sa'eed waghera toh farmate hain ke musalman ahl-e-qibla qaidi muraad hai, lekin Ibn Abbas waghera ka farmaan hai ke us waqt qaidiyon mein siwaaye mushrikeen ke aur koi muslim na tha, aur usi ki taayeed is hadith-e-shareef se bhi hoti hai jis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne badri qaidiyon ke baare mein apne ashab ko farmaya tha ke unka ikram karo. Chunancha khane peene mein sahaba khud apni jaan se bhi zyada unka khayal rakhte the. 

Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain ke isse muraad ghulaam hain. Imam Ibn Jareer (Rahimahullah / R.H) ba-sabab aayat ke aam hone ke isi ko pasand karte hain aur muslim o mushrik sab ko shaamil karte hain. 

Ghulaamon aur matahton ke saath ehsaan o sulook karne ki taakeed bohat si ahadeesin mein aayi hai, balke Rasool-e-Akram Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aakhri wasiyyat apni ummat ko yehi hai ke namazon ki nigahbaani karo aur apne matahton ke saath achha sulook karo aur unka poora khayal rakho.

Yeh us naik sulook ka na toh un logon se koi badla chahte hain na shukriya, balkay apne haal se goya elan kar detay hain ke hum tumhein sirf rahe Khuda detay hain is mein hamari hi behtari hai ke is se rizaye Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula hamein hasil ho jaye, hum sawab aur ajr ke mustahiq ho jayen, Hazrat Saeed (Rahimahullah) farmate hain Allah ki qasam yeh baat woh log munh se nahi nikaalte yeh dili irada hota hai jis ka ilm Allah ko hai toh Allah ne isay zahir farma diya ke aur logon ki raghbat ka baais banay, yeh pak-baaz jama'at khairat-o-sadqaat kar ke us din ke azab aur holnakiyon se bachna chahti hai jo tursh-ru, tang-o-tareek aur taweel-o-taweel hai, un ka aqeedah hai ke is bina par Allah un par raham karega aur us mohtaji aur bekasi walay din hamari nekiyan hamare kaam aayengi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se aboos ke maani tangi wala aur qamtrer ke maani taweel-taweel marwi hai, Ikrama farmate hain kafir ka munh us din bigad jayega us ki tiyori chadh jayegi aur us ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan se araq behne lagega jo misl roghan-e-gandhak ke hoga, Mujahid farmate hain hont chadh jayenge aur chehra simat jayega, Hazrat Saeed aur Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul hai ke wajah-e-ghabrahat aur holnakiyon ke soorat bigad jayegi peshani tang ho jayegi, Ibn Zaid farmate hain burai aur sakhti wala din hoga, lekin sab se wazeh, behtar, nihayat munasib, bilkul theek qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka hai (Razi Allahu Anhu), Qamtrer ke lughwi maani Imam Ibn Jareer ne shadeed ke kiye hain yaani bohat sakhti wala. Un ki is naik niyati aur pak amal ki wajah se Allah ne unhein us din ki burai se baal-baal bacha liya aur itna hi nahi balkay unhein bajae tursh-ruyi ke khanda-peshani aur bajae dil ki holnaaki ke itminan-o-suroor-e-qalb ata farmaya, khayal keejiye ke yahan ibarat mein kis qadar baleegh tajanus ka istemal kiya gaya hai aur jagah hai wujuhun yauma-izin musfiratun zahikatun mustabshirah, us din bohat se chehre chamakdar honge, jo hanste hue aur khushiyan manate hue honge, yeh zahir hai ke jab dil masroor hoga toh chehra khula hua hoga, Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik ki lambi hadith mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ko jab kabhi koi khushi hoti toh aap ka chehra chamakne lagta aur aisa maloom hota goya chand ka tukda hai, Hazrat Ayesha ki lambi hadith mein hai ke aik martba Huzoor ﷺ mere paas aaye chehra khushi se munawwar ho raha tha aur khade mubarak ki ragein chamak rahi thin, al-kh. Phir farmata hai un ke sabr ke ajr mein unhein rehne sehne ko wasee jannat, pak zindagi aur pehanne odhne ko reshmi libas mila, Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Sulaiman Darani ke samne is soorat ki tilawat hui jab qari ne is ayat ko padha to aap ne farmaya unhon ne dunyawi khwahishon ko chhod rakha tha phir yeh ashaar padhe: Afsos shahwat-e-nafs ne aur bhalaiyon ke khilaaf buraiyon ki chahat ne bohat se gawahon ka gala ghont diya aur kayi aik ko pa-ba-jolan kar diya, nafsani khwahishein hi hain jo insan ko badtareen zillat-o-ruswai aur bala-o-maseebat mein daal deti hain.

Un ki is naik niyati aur pak amal ki wajah se Allah ne unhein us din ki burai se baal-baal bacha liya aur itna hi nahi balkay unhein bajae tursh-ruyi ke khanda-peshani aur bajae dil ki holnaaki ke itminan-o-suroor-e-qalb ata farmaya, khayal keejiye ke yahan ibarat mein kis qadar baleegh tajanus ka istemal kiya gaya hai aur jagah hai wujuhun yauma-izin musfiratun zahikatun mustabshirah, us din bohat se chehre chamakdar honge, jo hanste hue aur khushiyan manate hue honge, yeh zahir hai ke jab dil masroor hoga toh chehra khula hua hoga, Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik ki lambi hadith mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ko jab kabhi koi khushi hoti toh aap ka chehra chamakne lagta aur aisa maloom hota goya chand ka tukda hai, Hazrat Ayesha ki lambi hadith mein hai ke aik martba Huzoor ﷺ mere paas aaye chehra khushi se munawwar ho raha tha aur khade mubarak ki ragein chamak rahi thin, al-kh. Phir farmata hai un ke sabr ke ajr mein unhein rehne sehne ko wasee jannat, pak zindagi aur pehanne odhne ko reshmi libas mila, Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Sulaiman Darani ke samne is soorat ki tilawat hui jab qari ne is ayat ko padha to aap ne farmaya unhon ne dunyawi khwahishon ko chhod rakha tha phir yeh ashaar padhe: Afsos shahwat-e-nafs ne aur bhalaiyon ke khilaaf buraiyon ki chahat ne bohat se gawahon ka gala ghont diya aur kayi aik ko pa-ba-jolan kar diya, nafsani khwahishein hi hain jo insan ko badtareen zillat-o-ruswai aur bala-o-maseebat mein daal deti hain.

Zanjeerein, tauq aur sholay! Yahan Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke uski makhlooq mein se jo bhi usse kufr kare uske liye zanjeerein, tauq aur sholon wali bhadakti hui tez aag tayyar hai, jaise aur jagah hai: "Idhil-aghlalu fi a'naqihim was-salasilu yushabuna fil-hamimi thumma fin-nari yusjarun" (jabke tauq unki gardanon mein honge aur beriyan unke paon mein hongi aur yeh hamim mein ghaseete jayenge phir jahannam mein jalaye jayenge). In bad-naseebon ki saza ka zikr kar ke ab naik logon ki jaza ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhe woh jaam pilaye jayenge jinka mashroob kafoor naami nahar ke pani ka hoga, zaika bhi aala, khushbu bhi umdah aur faida bhi behtar, kafoor ki si thandak aur sonth ki si khushbu. Kafoor ek nahar ka naam hai jisse Allah ke khas bande pani peete hain aur sirf usi se aasudgi haasil karte hain, isiliye yahan isko "ba" se muta'addi kiya aur tameez ki bina par "ainal" par nasb diya. Yeh pani apni khushbu mein misl kafoor ke hai ya yeh theek kafoor hi hai aur ainal ka zabr yashrab ki wajah se hai. Phir is nahar tak unhe aane ki zaroorat nahi, yeh apne baghaat, makaanat, majlison aur baithkon mein jahan bhi jayenge is le jayenge aur wahin woh pahunch jayegi. Tafjeer ke maikhne rawani aur ijra ke hain, jaise aayat "Hatta tufajir lana" mein aur "Fajr-na khilalahuma" mein. 

Phir un logon ki nekiyan bayan ho rahi hain ke jo ibaadat Allah ki taraf se unke zimmah thi woh baja late thay balke jo cheez yeh apne upar kar lete use bhi baja late yaani nazr bhi poori karte. Hadees mein hai: "Jo Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ki nazr maane woh poori kare aur jo na-farmani ki nazr maane use poora na kare." Imam Bukhari ne ise Imam Malik ki riwayat se bayan farmaya. Zameen-o-asman tak haul rahe honge, istitaar ke maikhne hi hain phail jaane wali aur atraaf ko gher lene wali ke hain. Yeh neko-kaar Allah ki mohabbat mein mustahiq logon par apni taaqat ke mutabiq kharch bhi karte rehte thay aur "la" ki zameer ka marja baaz logon ne ta'am ko bhi kaha hai, lafzan zyada zahir bhi yahi hai, yaani bawajood ta'am ki mohabbat aur khwahish-o-zaroorat ke bawajood rah-e-Allah ghurba aur haajat-mandon ko de dete hain.

Jaise aur jagah hai: Wa atal-mala 'ala hubbihi, yaani maal ki chaahat ke bawajood use raah-e-Allah dete rehte hain, aur farmaan hai: Lan tanalul-birra hatta tunfiqo mimma tuhibbun, yaani tum hargiz bhalai haasil nahi kar sakte jab tak apni chaahat ki cheezein raah-e-Allah kharch na karo. 

Hazrat Nafi' farmate hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bimaar hue, aap ki bimaari mein angoor ka mausam aaya. Jab angoor bikne lage toh aap ka dil bhi chaaha ke main angoor khaoon. Aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Safiyah ne ek dirham ke angoor mangaye. Aadmi lekar aaya, uske saath hi saath ek sail bhi aa gaya aur usne aawaaz di ke main sail hoon. Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Yeh sab usi ko de do, chunancha de diye gaye. Phir dobaara aadmi gaya aur angoor khareed laya, ab ki martaba bhi sail aa gaya aur uske sawaal par usi ko sab ke sab angoor de diye gaye. Lekin ab ki martaba Hazrat Safiyah ne sail ko kahalwa bheja ke agar ab aaye toh tumhe kuch na milega. Chunancha teesri martaba ek dirham ke angoor mangwaye gaye (Baihaqi). 

Aur sahih hadith mein hai ke afzal sadaqa woh hai jo tu apni sehat ki haalat mein maal ki mohabbat, ameeri ki chaahat aur iflaas ke khauf ke bawajood raah-e-Allah de. Yaani maal ki hirs, hub bhi aur chaahat o zaroorat bhi ho, phir bhi raah-e-Allah use qurbaan kar de.

Yeh us naik sulook ka na toh un logon se koi badla chahte hain na shukriya, balkay apne haal se goya elan kar detay hain ke hum tumhein sirf rahe Khuda detay hain is mein hamari hi behtari hai ke is se rizaye Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula hamein hasil ho jaye, hum sawab aur ajr ke mustahiq ho jayen, Hazrat Saeed (Rahimahullah) farmate hain Allah ki qasam yeh baat woh log munh se nahi nikaalte yeh dili irada hota hai jis ka ilm Allah ko hai toh Allah ne isay zahir farma diya ke aur logon ki raghbat ka baais banay, yeh pak-baaz jama'at khairat-o-sadqaat kar ke us din ke azab aur holnakiyon se bachna chahti hai jo tursh-ru, tang-o-tareek aur taweel-o-taweel hai, un ka aqeedah hai ke is bina par Allah un par raham karega aur us mohtaji aur bekasi walay din hamari nekiyan hamare kaam aayengi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se aboos ke maani tangi wala aur qamtrer ke maani taweel-taweel marwi hai, Ikrama farmate hain kafir ka munh us din bigad jayega us ki tiyori chadh jayegi aur us ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan se araq behne lagega jo misl roghan-e-gandhak ke hoga, Mujahid farmate hain hont chadh jayenge aur chehra simat jayega, Hazrat Saeed aur Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul hai ke wajah-e-ghabrahat aur holnakiyon ke soorat bigad jayegi peshani tang ho jayegi, Ibn Zaid farmate hain burai aur sakhti wala din hoga, lekin sab se wazeh, behtar, nihayat munasib, bilkul theek qaul Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka hai (Razi Allahu Anhu), Qamtrer ke lughwi maani Imam Ibn Jareer ne shadeed ke kiye hain yaani bohat sakhti wala. Un ki is naik niyati aur pak amal ki wajah se Allah ne unhein us din ki burai se baal-baal bacha liya aur itna hi nahi balkay unhein bajae tursh-ruyi ke khanda-peshani aur bajae dil ki holnaaki ke itminan-o-suroor-e-qalb ata farmaya, khayal keejiye ke yahan ibarat mein kis qadar baleegh tajanus ka istemal kiya gaya hai aur jagah hai wujuhun yauma-izin musfiratun zahikatun mustabshirah, us din bohat se chehre chamakdar honge, jo hanste hue aur khushiyan manate hue honge, yeh zahir hai ke jab dil masroor hoga toh chehra khula hua hoga, Hazrat Ka'b bin Malik ki lambi hadith mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ko jab kabhi koi khushi hoti toh aap ka chehra chamakne lagta aur aisa maloom hota goya chand ka tukda hai, Hazrat Ayesha ki lambi hadith mein hai ke aik martba Huzoor ﷺ mere paas aaye chehra khushi se munawwar ho raha tha aur khade mubarak ki ragein chamak rahi thin, al-kh. Phir farmata hai un ke sabr ke ajr mein unhein rehne sehne ko wasee jannat, pak zindagi aur pehanne odhne ko reshmi libas mila, Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Sulaiman Darani ke samne is soorat ki tilawat hui jab qari ne is ayat ko padha to aap ne farmaya unhon ne dunyawi khwahishon ko chhod rakha tha phir yeh ashaar padhe: Afsos shahwat-e-nafs ne aur bhalaiyon ke khilaaf buraiyon ki chahat ne bohat se gawahon ka gala ghont diya aur kayi aik ko pa-ba-jolan kar diya, nafsani khwahishein hi hain jo insan ko badtareen zillat-o-ruswai aur bala-o-maseebat mein daal deti hain.

Daimi khushgawar mausam aur masarratoon se bharpoor zindagi Ahl-e-Jannat ki naimat, rahat, un ke mulk-o-maal aur jah-o-manal ka zikr ho raha hai ke yeh log ba-aram-e-tamam poore itmi'nan aur khush-dili ke sath Jannat ke mursaa, muzaynam, jada'u takhton par be-fikri se takkiye lagaye suroor aur rahat se baithe maze loot rahe honge, Surah As-Saffat ki tafseer mein is ki poori sharah guzar chuki hai, wahin yeh bhi bayan ho chuka hai ke ittika se murad leitna hai ya kohniyan tikana hai ya chaar zano baithna hai ya kamar laga kar tek lagana hai, aur yeh bhi bayan ho chuka hai ke araik chhappar khaton ko kehte hain, phir ek aur naimat bayan ho rahi hai ki wahan na to sooraj ki tez shoa'on se unhein koi takleef pohnche na jare ki bohat sard hawayein unhein nagawar guzrein balkih bahaar ka sa mausam har waqt aur hamesha rehta hai garmi sardi ke jhameelon se alag hain, Jannati darakhtoon ki shakhain jhoom jhoom kar un par saya kiye hue hongi aur meway un se bilkul qareeb honge chahe leite leite tor kar khalein, chahe baithe baithe le lein chahe khare ho kar le lein darakhtoon par charhne aur takleef ki koi hajat nahi par mewa-dar lachhe aur lade hue lachhe latak rahe hain tora aur khaliya agar khare hain toh meway itne oonche hain baithe toh qadare jhuk gaye leite toh aur qareeb aagaye, na to kaanto ki rukawat na doori ki sardardi hai, Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) farmate hain Jannat ki zameen chandi ki hai aur is ki mitti mushk-e-khalis hai is ke darakhtoon ke tane sone chandi ke hain daliyan lolo zabarjad aur yaqoot ki hain, un ke darmiyan patte aur phal hain jin ke torne mein koi waqt aur mushkil nahi chaho baithe baithe tor lo chaho khare khare balkih agar chahein leite leite ek taraf khush-khram, khush-dil, khoobsurat, ba-adab, saleeqa-shoar, farman-bardar khadim qism qism ke khane chandi ki kashtiyon mein lagaye liye khare hain. Doosri janib sharab-e-tohoor se chhalakte hue baloreen jaam liye saqiyan-e-mahvash isharay ke muntazir hain, yeh glass safai mein sheeshe jaise aur safedi mein chandi jaise honge, darasal honge chandi ke lekin sheeshe ki tarah shafaf honge ke andar ki cheez bahar se nazar aaye, Jannat ki tamam cheezon ki yoonhi si barai-naam mushabihat duniya ki cheezon mein bhi payi jati hai lekin in chandi ke baloreen glasson ki koi nazir nahi milti, han yeh yaad rahe ke pehle ke lafz qawarir par zabar toh isliye hai ki woh kaan ki khabar hai aur doosre par zabar ya toh badliyat ki bina par hai ya tameez ki bina par, phir yeh jaam nape tule hue hain saqi ke haath mein bhi zeb dein aur un ki hatheliyon par bhale maloom hon aur peene walon ke hasb-e-khwahish sharab-e-tohoor is mein sama jaye jo na bache na ghate.

Inn nayab gilason mein jo pak, khush-zaiqa aur suroor wali be-nashe ki sharab unhein milegi woh Jannat ki nehar Salsabil ke pani se makhloot kar ke di jayegi, ooper guzar chuka hai ke nehar Kafur ke pani se makhloot kar ke di jayegi to matlab yeh hai kabhi is thandak wale sard mizaj pani se kabhi is nafees garm mizaj pani se taake aitadal qaim rahe, yeh Abrar logon ka zikr hai aur khas Muqarrabeen khalis is nehar ka sharbat piyenge, Salsabil ba-qaul-e-Ikrimah Jannat ke aik chashme ka naam hai kyunke woh tezi ke sath musalsal rawangi se lahrayata chal beh raha hai, uska pani bara halka, nihayat shireen, khush-zaiqa aur khush-bo hai jo asani se piya jaye aur hazam aur juz-e-badan hota rahe. 

In naimaton ke sath hi khoobsurat haseen nou-khaiz kam-umar larke unki khidmat ke liye kamar-basta honge, yeh Ghilman-e-Jannati jis sun-o-sal mein honge usi mein rahenge yeh nahi ke sun barh kar soorat bigar jaye, nafees poshakein aur besh-qimat jarah zewar pehne ba-taadad-e-kaseer idhar udhar mukhtarif kamon par bate hue honge jinhein dor bhag kar mustadi aur chalaki se anjam de rahe honge aisa maloom hoga goya safaid ab-dar moti idhar udhar Jannat mein bikhre pare hain. Haqeeqat mein is se ziyada achhi tashbeh unke liye koi aur na thi ke yeh sahib-e-jamal khush-khisal bote se qad wale safaid noorani chehron wale pak-saf sajhi hui poshakein pehne zewar mein lade apne Malik ki farmanbardari mein daurte bhagte idhar udhar phirte aise bhale maloom honge saje sajaye pur-takalluf farsh par safaid chamkayle sache moti idhar udhar lurak rahe hon, Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain har har Jannati ke aik hazaar khadim honge jo mukhtarif kaam-kaaj mein lage hue honge. 

Phir farmata hai Ae Nabi tum Jannat ki jis jagah nazar dalo tumhein naimatein aur azeem-ush-shan saltanat nazar ayegi tum dekhoge ke rahat-o-suroor naimat-o-noor se chapa chap mamoor hai chunache sahih hadith mein hai ke sab se akhir mein jo Jahannam mein se nikala jayega aur Jannat mein bheja jayega us se Janab-e-Bari Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmayega ja main ne tujhe Jannat mein woh diya jo misl duniya ke hai, balki is se bhi das hisse ziyada diya, aur Hazrat Ibn Umar ki riwayat se woh hadith bhi pehle guzar chuki hai jis mein hai ke adna Jannati ki malkiyat-o-mulk do hazaar saal tak hoga har qareeb-o-baeed ki cheez par uski be-nakar yaksan nigahein hongi, yeh hal to hai adna Jannati ka phir samajh lo ke aala Jannati ka darja kya hoga? Aur uski naimatein kaisi hongi (Ae Allah ae baghair hamari dua aur amal ke humein sheer-e-madar ke chashme anayat karne wale hum ba-ajizi wa iltijah teri pak janab mein arz guzar hain ke tu hamare mushtaq dil ke arman poore kar aur humein bhi Jannat-ul-Firdaus naseeb farma. Go aise amal na hon lekin iman hai ke teri rehmat amal par hi mauqoof nahi, Ameen).

(Mutarjim) Tabarani ki aik bohat hi ghareeb hadith mein وارد hai ke aik habshi darbar-e-risalat mein hazir hua, Aap ne use farmaya tumhein jo kuch poochhna ho jis baat ko samajhna ho pooch lo us ne kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ surat, shakal, rang, roop, nubuwwat-o-risalat mein aap ko hum par fazilat di gayi hai ab yeh to farmayiye ke agar main bhi un cheezon par iman laoon jin par aap iman laye hain aur jin par aap amal karte hain agar main bhi isi par amal karoon toh kya jannat mein aap ke sath ho sakta hoon? Aap ne farmaya haan qasam hai us Allah ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke siyah rang logon ko jannat mein woh safed rang diya jayega ke aik hazar saal ke fasle se dikhayi dega phir Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs La ilaha illallah kahe us ke liye Allah ke pas ahd muqarrar ho jata hai aur jo shakhs Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi kahe us ke liye aik lakh chaubis hazar nekiyan likhi jati hain, toh aik shakhs ne kaha phir ya Rasulullah ﷺ hum kaise haal honge? Aap ne farmaya suno aik shakhs itni nekiyan layega ke agar kisi bare pahaad par rakhi jayen toh us par boojhal paden lekin phir jo Allah ki naqamatein us ke muqabil aayengi toh qareeb hoga ke sab fana ho jayen magar yeh aur baat hai ke rehmat-e-Rab tavajju farmaye us waqt yeh surat mulkan kabeera tak utri usi habshi ne kaha ke aye Huzoor jo kuch aap ki aankhein jannat mein dekhengi kya meri aankhein bhi dekhengi? Aap ne farmaya haan haan, bas woh rane laga yahan tak ke us ki rooh parwaz kar gayi Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain maine dekha ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne hath se use dafan kiya R.A. Phir ahl-e-jannat ke libas ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh sabz hare rang ka maheen aur chamakdar resham hoga, Sundus aala darje ka khalis narm resham jo badan se laga hua hoga, aur Istabraq umda besh-baha giran-qadr resham jis mein chamak damak hogi jo upar pahunchaya jayega, sath hi chandi ke kangan hathon mein honge, yeh libas Abrar ka hai, aur Muqarrabeen khaas ke bare mein aur jagah irshad hai (Yuhallawna fiha min asawira min zahabin wa lu'lu'an wa libasuhum fiha hareera 23) (Surah Al-Hajj: 23) Inhein sone ke kangan hire jade hue pehnaye jayenge aur khaas narm saf re-shmi libas hoga, un zahiri jismani istemali naqamaton ke sath hi inhein pur-kaif, ba-lazzat, suroor wali, pak aur pak karne wali sharab pilayi jayegi jo tamam zahiri batini burai door kar de hasad kina bad-khulqi ghussa waghera sab door kar de, jaise Ameer-ul-Mumineen Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A se marwi hai ke jab ahl-e-jannat jannat ke darwaze par pahunchenge toh inhein do nahrein nazar aayengi aur inhein az-khud khayal paida hoga aik ka woh pani piyenge toh un ke dilon mein jab kuch tha sab door ho jayega dusri mein ghusal karenge jis se chehre taru-taza hashash-bashash ho jayenge, zahiri aur batini khubi dono inhein badarja-e-kamaal hasil hongi jis ka bayan yahan ho raha hai.

Phir un se un ke dil khush karne aur un ki khushi do-bala karne ko baar baar kaha jayega tumhare naik aamal ka badla aur tumhari bhali koshish ki qadr-dani hai, jaise aur jagah hai (Kulu washrabu haniam bima aslaftum fil-ayyamil-khaliyah 69. Al-Haqqah: 24) duniya mein jo aamal tum ne kiye un ki naik jaza mein aaj tum khoob lateef-o-lazeez ba-aram-o-itminan khate peete raho, aur farman hai wa nudoo an tilkumul-jannatu urithtuha bima kuntum ta'maloon ya'ni munadi kiye jayenge ke un jannaton ka waris tumhein tumhare naik kirdar ki bina par banaya gaya hai, yahan bhi farmaya hai tumhari sa'i mashkoor hai thode amal par bohat ajr hai. Allah Ta'ala humein un mein se kare Ameen.

Inn nayab gilason mein jo pak, khush-zaiqa aur suroor wali be-nashe ki sharab unhein milegi woh Jannat ki nehar Salsabil ke pani se makhloot kar ke di jayegi, ooper guzar chuka hai ke nehar Kafur ke pani se makhloot kar ke di jayegi to matlab yeh hai kabhi is thandak wale sard mizaj pani se kabhi is nafees garm mizaj pani se taake aitadal qaim rahe, yeh Abrar logon ka zikr hai aur khas Muqarrabeen khalis is nehar ka sharbat piyenge, Salsabil ba-qaul-e-Ikrimah Jannat ke aik chashme ka naam hai kyunke woh tezi ke sath musalsal rawangi se lahrayata chal beh raha hai, uska pani bara halka, nihayat shireen, khush-zaiqa aur khush-bo hai jo asani se piya jaye aur hazam aur juz-e-badan hota rahe. 

In naimaton ke sath hi khoobsurat haseen nou-khaiz kam-umar larke unki khidmat ke liye kamar-basta honge, yeh Ghilman-e-Jannati jis sun-o-sal mein honge usi mein rahenge yeh nahi ke sun barh kar soorat bigar jaye, nafees poshakein aur besh-qimat jarah zewar pehne ba-taadad-e-kaseer idhar udhar mukhtarif kamon par bate hue honge jinhein dor bhag kar mustadi aur chalaki se anjam de rahe honge aisa maloom hoga goya safaid ab-dar moti idhar udhar Jannat mein bikhre pare hain. Phir un se un ke dil khush karne aur un ki khushi do-bala karne ko baar baar kaha jayega tumhare naik aamal ka badla aur tumhari bhali koshish ki qadr-dani hai, jaise aur jagah hai (Kulu washrabu haniam bima aslaftum fil-ayyamil-khaliyah 69. Allah Ta'ala aur Muhammad ﷺ ka baham ahd-o-muamalat:

Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ par apna jo khas karam kiya hai use yaad dilata hai ke hum ne tujh par batadrij thoda thoda kar ke yeh Quran-e-Kareem nazil farmaya ab is ikram ke muqable mein tumhe bhi chahiye ke meri rah mein sabr-o-zabt se kaam lo, meri qaza-o-qadar par sabir-o-shakir raho dekho to sahi ke main apne husn-e-tadbeer se tumhe kahan se kahan pohanchata hoon. In kafiron munafiqon ki baaton mein na aana goya tabligh se roken lekin tum na rukna bila ro-o-riayat mayusi aur takan ke baghair har waqt waaz, nasihat, irshad-o-talqin se gharz rakho meri zaat par bharosa rakho main tumhe logon ki eza se bachaaunga, tumhari ismat ka zimmedar main hoon, fajir kehte hain, bad-amal aasi ko aur kafour kehte hain dil ke munkir ko, din ke awwal akhir hisse mein Rab ka naam liya karo, raaton ko tahajjud ki namaz padho aur der tak Allah ki tasbeeh karo, jaise aur jagah farmaya ayat (Wa min al-laili fatahajjad bihi nafilatal laka 'asa an yab'athaka Rabbuka maqaman mahmuda) (17. Al-Isra: 79), raat ko tahajjud padho anqareeb tumhe tumhara Rab Maqaam-e-Mahmoud mein pohanchaega, Surah Muzzammil ke shuru mein farmaya 'Ayyuhal-muzzammil qumil-laila illa qalila' raat ka قیام kar magar thodi raat, aadhe ya is se kuch kam ya kuch zyada aur Quran ko tarteel se padh. 

Phir kuffar ko rokta hai ke hubb-e-duniya mein phans kar akhirat ko tark na karo woh bada bhari din hai, is fani duniya ke peeche pad kar is khaufnak din ki dushwariyoon se ghafil hojana aqalmandi ka kaam nahi phir farmata hai sab ke khaliq hum hain aur sab ki mazboot paidaish aur qawi aaza hum ne hi banaye hain aur hum bilkul hi qadir hain ke qayamat ke din unhein badal kar nayi paidaish mein paida kardein, yahan ibtida-e-afrinish ko aada ki daleel banaya aur is ayat ka yeh matlab bhi hai ke agar hum chahein aur jab chahein humein qudrat hasil hai ke unhein fana kardein mita dein aur un jaise doosre insano ko un ke qaim maqam kardein.
